# Hardware compatibility

<!-- Generated by python -m ha_growatt.hardware_matrix; edit hardware_evidence.json. -->

Evidence checked: 2026-09-21.

Results apply only to the hardware, firmware, connection and software listed. Reports from another project do not verify HA Growatt. A successful read does not prove a control works.

The verified installation contains two inverters. The owner identified one as a
MIN 2500TL-XH; the model-to-feed mapping and datalogger variants still need
confirmation. We cannot yet publish a complete model/firmware combination as
hardware-qualified. Battery controls have no physical qualification here.

An unlisted model is unverified, not necessarily unsupported. Start with
[the installation guide](guided-setup.md) and leave experimental controls off.

<a id="verified-installation"></a>

## MIN 2500TL-XH and one unidentified inverter

**Evidence:** Verified installation

**Software or source project:** HA Growatt 0.3.2

**Firmware:** GH1.0 and AL1.0 observed across the pair; model-to-feed mapping unconfirmed

**Datalogger:** Model and firmware unconfirmed

**Connection:** Growatt datalogger TCP proxy

**Readings:** Fresh readings, cloud forwarding, MQTT discovery, restart and history preservation verified.

**Controls:** Not physically qualified; no battery qualification.

**Profile guidance:** Retain the installation's working Automatic selection.

**Limits:** The owner identified one inverter as a MIN 2500TL-XH on 21 September 2026. The two feeds jointly preserve 64 measurement entities. Exact model-to-feed mapping, second model and datalogger variants remain unconfirmed. No battery control was physically qualified.

- [HA Growatt compatibility checks](https://github.com/Herbertmt978/HA-Growatt/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md)
- [Verified 0.3.2 release](https://github.com/Herbertmt978/HA-Growatt/releases/tag/v0.3.2)

<a id="spa3000tl-bl"></a>

## SPA3000TL BL

**Evidence:** Community report — mixed results

**Software or source project:** FezVrasta/growatt-datalogger, reports through 0.10.0

**Firmware:** Not qualified here

**Datalogger:** Shine datalogger; exact variant not qualified here

**Connection:** Growatt datalogger TCP

**Readings:** Settings readback reported; this AC-coupled storage model has no direct PV input.

**Controls:** ShinePhone-to-HA refresh confirmed by reporter. HA writes had confirmation problems; 0.10.0 adds a fix, with no later reporter confirmation in the checked thread.

**Profile guidance:** SPA readings; SPA battery controls only with experimental controls enabled.

**Limits:** Not tested with HA Growatt. A closed issue is not physical confirmation of the final fix.

- [SPA control field report](https://github.com/FezVrasta/growatt-datalogger/issues/2)
- [SPA solar-data discussion](https://github.com/FezVrasta/growatt-datalogger/issues/5)

<a id="mid25ktl3-xh"></a>

## MID 25KTL3-XH

**Evidence:** Community report — different connection

**Software or source project:** 0xAHA/Growatt_ModbusTCP

**Firmware:** Exact firmware not qualified here; reported protocol 2.02

**Datalogger:** Modbus gateway, not HA Growatt's datalogger proxy

**Connection:** Direct Modbus TCP/RTU

**Readings:** Model-specific register evidence; not a HA Growatt telemetry test.

**Controls:** Reporter confirmed battery charge limit at 3048 and discharge reserve at 3067; SPH register writes were rejected.

**Profile guidance:** MOD/MID TL3-XH experimental controls, only after confirming the exact model and successful reads.

**Limits:** Direct Modbus success does not establish support through a Shine datalogger. HA Growatt does not provide a direct Modbus client.

- [MID hardware measurements](https://github.com/0xAHA/Growatt_ModbusTCP/issues/362)

<a id="min-tl-xh"></a>

## MIN TL-XH

**Evidence:** Documented — hardware verification needed

**Software or source project:** Growatt protocol documentation; HA Growatt protocol tests

**Firmware:** Not hardware-qualified

**Datalogger:** Not hardware-qualified

**Connection:** Documented Modbus registers

**Readings:** MIN protocol-6 layout implemented; this does not qualify every MIN model.

**Controls:** Charge power 3047, charge limit 3048 and grid charging 3049 are implemented as experimental controls.

**Profile guidance:** MIN readings; MIN TL-XH battery controls only for matching hardware.

**Limits:** No SPH schedules. Reads, write confirmation and physical battery behaviour require separate verification.

- [Control register evidence](https://github.com/Herbertmt978/HA-Growatt/blob/main/docs/hardware-support.md)

<a id="encrypted-shine"></a>

## SPH with session-key encrypted Shine traffic

**Evidence:** Known limitation

**Software or source project:** FezVrasta/growatt-datalogger and Grott field report

**Firmware:** Exact affected versions not established

**Datalogger:** ShineWiFi; session-key handshake reported

**Connection:** Encrypted datalogger TCP

**Readings:** Session-key encrypted telemetry is unsupported by HA Growatt.

**Controls:** Not available without a supported decoded connection.

**Profile guidance:** No profile change decrypts this traffic.

**Limits:** Do not assume every ShineWiFi or every newer firmware is affected. Identify the actual protocol from diagnostics.

- [Open encrypted-session report](https://github.com/FezVrasta/growatt-datalogger/issues/3)

## Add or correct evidence

[Send a hardware report](https://github.com/Herbertmt978/HA-Growatt/issues/new?template=hardware-report.yml).
Include exact model, inverter and datalogger firmware, connection, software version,
profile and what you actually observed. Do not publish serial numbers, credentials
or raw packet captures. Readings, setting readback, write acknowledgement and
physical behaviour are separate results. No setting change is needed to report
working telemetry. A closed issue or passing protocol test alone is not
hardware verification.
